root_cause: A Mira Reel was published through a Composio Instagram credential resolving to the personal username arthurprinsen because provider-user identity was checked without enforcing the account role.
prevention: Mira may never publish to the personal Instagram identity arthurprinsen.
Mira requires an explicitly verified Bedrijfsgeheugen/business Instagram identity before any provider side effect.
Credential dedupe must preserve account role; same provider identity is not sufficient if the role is personal.
